mechanism: Isoniazid is hepatotoxic and may impair naltrexone metabolism via CYP3A4 inhibition, while naltrexone's hepatic effects could compound isoniazid-induced liver injury risk.
action: Monitor liver function tests (AST, ALT, bilirubin) regularly; consider alternative opioid antagonist if hepatic impairment develops or use with caution in patients with pre-existing liver disease.
